name: relvoca-site
description: Local RelVoca site build. Started as an offline HTTrack capture of www.voiceflow.com (2-3 Sep 2026), rebranded to RelVoca on 5 Sep 2026. Not an archive any more, and not redistributable or deployable.

baseline.note: Regression gate for `npm run verify`. MISSING must never rise above baselineMissing. If a change increases it, revert the change - do not raise the baseline. Lower it deliberately, in the same commit, when a repair genuinely fixes references.
baseline.measures: Served tree only. tools/audit.js does not skip _quarantine/, so tools/verify.js discounts missing refs originating in _quarantine/ backups before comparing. baselineMissing is therefore lower than the raw missingTotal in tools/audit-report.json whenever a backup is present there.

history.note: before section landing pages were restored to the mirror root
settled after reference repair. Remaining load is 641 refs to 68 uncaptured /docs/_next chunks, plus docs-page relative refs and permanent crawler debris. Cannot reach zero.

as measured immediately before AND after the RelVoca rebrand - unchanged. NOTE: this is the raw audit.js number, which already exceeded baselineMissing (2302) before any rebrand work began; see preExistingGateFailure below.

preExistingGateFailure.note: `npm run verify` was already FAILING by +3124 before the rebrand, on an untouched tree. The rebrand did not change it: missingTotal and missingDistinct are identical before and after. Diagnose the gate separately - RESUME.md records that audit.js over-reports and keeps drifting from serve.js resolution rules.

rebranded.scope: visible text, wordmark, favicons, and product links to creator/docs/status/trust/link/media.voiceflow.com
rebranded.note: Visible text only. Paths, href/src values, hashed asset names and CSS tokens were not touched, and the on-disk directory www.voiceflow.com/ must keep its name (see tools/ROUTES.md). Reference counts were unchanged by the rebrand.
